basis: Forebrain malformation; central diabetes insipidus affects about 70% in classic holoprosencephaly. HPE6-specific endocrine frequency is uncertain.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: involved: hypothalamic-pituitary dysfunction, especially central diabetes insipidus (~70%), is common in holoprosencephaly; subtype-specific frequency is uncertain.

basis: Glycosylation defect with defining encephalopathy and gastric bleeding; hearing loss 30-79%. Frequent visual impairment may be cerebral; intrinsic ocular damage is unconfirmed.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: persistent vomiting and gastric bleeding are explicit defining manifestations; bleeding establishes gastrointestinal injury.
decisions.ocular: none: visual impairment (30-79%) does not localize damage to the eye in this encephalopathy; strabismus is only 5-29%.

basis: Mitochondrial disorder with defining severe encephalopathy; hearing impairment and microcytic anemia each reported in 1/1. Muscle DNA depletion alone does not establish myopathy.

decisions.neurologic: primary: structural brain abnormality, seizures and severe motor dysfunction define the reported encephalopathic phenotype (1/1).

basis: Immune-mediated ulcerative chilblain lupus; digital autoamputation in 1/3 (~33%) establishes destructive limb involvement. Arthralgia alone would not qualify.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: digital autoamputation in 1/3 (~33%) represents irreversible loss of musculoskeletal structures, beyond arthralgia.

basis: Contractures and neurodevelopmental impairment define CLIFAHDD; strabismus occurs in 30-79%. Constipation/reflux lack evidence of direct bowel injury; breathing abnormalities may be central.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: constipation (5/6) and reflux (9/11) do not establish direct intestinal injury or primary dysmotility; reflux is also a separate diagnosis.
decisions.ocular: involved: strabismus is frequent (30-79%) and represents persistent ocular alignment dysfunction.

basis: Defining chronic sinobronchial disease; recurrent otitis (30-79%) is a separate infection and hearing impairment is only 5-29%. Reproductive obstruction has no axis.

decisions.otologic: none: recurrent otitis (30-79%) is a separately diagnosed infection; persistent hearing impairment is only 5-29%.

basis: Lipodystrophy with severe metabolic dysfunction; phalangeal osteolysis occurs in 30-79%. Steatosis and atherosclerosis are separate diseases; hepatomegaly alone does not establish liver damage.

decisions.hepatic: none: steatosis (30-79%) is a separately diagnosed metabolic liver complication; hepatomegaly (80-99%) alone does not establish impaired liver function.

basis: Immune myositis; swallowing dysfunction from pharyngoesophageal muscle involvement and sclerodactyly each occur in 30-79%. Interstitial pulmonary abnormalities occur in only 5-29%.

decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: dysphagia (30-79%) reflects direct inflammatory dysfunction of swallowing/upper esophageal muscles in myositis.

basis: Peroxisomal metabolic disorder; definition explicitly specifies chondrodysplasia despite absent skeletal HPO findings. Severe CNS disease in 3/3; cataracts in 2/3 (~67%).

decisions.ocular: involved: cataracts cause intrinsic lens dysfunction in 2/3 (~67%); three defining axes already occupy the primary cap.
decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: the supplied definition explicitly specifies rhizomelic chondrodysplasia punctata, reinforced by skeletal-dysplasia ancestry; skeletal HPO support is absent.

basis: Congenitally short intestine causes malabsorption. Cognitive impairment (30-79%) does not establish direct CNS involvement; nutritional sequelae and syndromic subtypes may account for it.

decisions.neurologic: none: cognitive impairment is annotated 30-79%, but direct CNS disease is unestablished; malnutrition or selected syndromic subtypes may explain it.
